# Eduard Makedonskii — Senior DevOps Engineer & Mentor (full content)

> Eduard Makedonskii (Эдуард Македонский) is a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer based in Russia
> with 13+ years of infrastructure experience, the last 6 of which in DevOps. He holds the CKA
> (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) certification. He works remotely worldwide and is open
> to part-time / contract engagements as well as 1-on-1 DevOps and SRE mentoring.

## How to reach Eduard for mentoring or hire

The fastest way is Telegram: [@edmak](https://t.me/edmak). Email also works:
eduard.devops@gmail.com. Format and pricing are agreed in chat.

For **mentoring**, Eduard works with junior, middle and senior DevOps engineers, career
switchers entering DevOps, and startup founders who need to bootstrap or accelerate
DevOps practices.

For **part-time / contract / one-off engagements**, Eduard takes on projects involving
Kubernetes, GitOps, Terraform, AWS / GCP / Yandex Cloud, observability, and CI/CD.
He works remotely (base time zone: Moscow / MSK) for clients in Russia and abroad.

---

## Approach to mentoring

Eduard is strongly against "interview-hacking" schools — he shares real knowledge and
experience, not scripted answers, though he will share practical preparation insights.
He has broad exposure across many different projects and brings an outside-in view on
real engineering tasks and architecture. His core specialization is CI/CD and the
automation around it; he also has experience with high-load systems and observability.

## Selected experience (recent)

### Mar 2025 — Present · Senior DevOps Engineer · Project-based
- **Security MVP (under NDA):** automated deployment of production security nodes
  (Python, IaC); greenfield infrastructure on Selectel (Terraform, Ansible);
  dev platform — GitLab, SonarQube, Keycloak, Vault, OpenProject;
  threat intelligence (OpenSearch + connectors); observability (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana);
  encrypted backups (restic + S3).
- **litegallery.io:** resolved OOM incidents, set up autoscaling (HPA), improved uptime;
  migrated Docker Swarm → Kubernetes (GitOps via ArgoCD); CI/CD on
  GitLab CI / ArgoCD / Helm; preparing to drop Rancher; participating in DevOps hiring.
- **pingmap.ru** — pet project / infrastructure playground: distributed Go/gRPC agents,
  microservices, NATS, ClickHouse.

### Jun 2024 — Feb 2025 · Senior DevOps Engineer · MTS / KION (streaming platform)
Built new infrastructure for an online cinema platform: dev/stage/prod with
geo-redundancy. Microservice management with Helm/Kubernetes; releases and
environments as code. CI/CD pipelines for both services and platform; artifacts in
Harbor/Artifactory. Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Sentry, VictoriaMetrics.
HLD/LLD diagrams, contributed to architecture decisions; load testing.
Ansible/Terraform for provisioning and management; Vault for secrets.

### Aug 2022 — Apr 2024 · Senior DevOps Engineer · Azul (Azul JDK — Cyprus)
Built a new highly-available Jenkins via IaC; migrations and DR procedures.
Rolled out Nexus; supported Azul JDK builds across multiple platforms.
Published images to Docker Hub (azul/zulu-openjdk). Mentored a junior engineer.
SOC 2-aligned SDLC. Cut AWS spend ~×2 via cleanups, right-sizing, tagging,
and CloudHealth reports.

### Aug 2021 — Jul 2022 · DevOps Engineer · Cyberprotect (formerly Acronis Infozaschita)
Migrated Jenkins installations (freestyle / JJB). Moved to IaC (Ansible / Job DSL /
Groovy libs). Make, Docker, Helm; npm / PyPI / RPM; Artifactory, registry, ChartMuseum.
Python scripts for API integrations; production cloud rollout (Ansible). Zabbix.
On-prem Atlassian admin (Bitbucket / Jira / Confluence). Outcome: relocated build
infrastructure from a global parent company to the local entity.

### Feb 2019 — Aug 2021 · SDET · Wallarm
**FAST (DAST scanner):** build / test / release; CI/CD integrations
(GitLab, Jenkins, CircleCI, Bamboo, Azure DevOps). OWASP Top 10 security tests;
automation (Python + pytest + requests + Allure); demos and docs.
**WAF Node:** Jenkins release pipeline (scripted, Packer, Make/CMake);
install tests (Ansible/Terraform/bash); RSpec; releases for
Debian/Ubuntu/CentOS/AL2, Docker/Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Yandex.
Outcome: release cycle cut from ~2 months to 2 weeks.

### Jun 2017 — Feb 2019 · Senior QA Engineer · Security Code
**UTM Continent 4:** functional, integration, and load testing
(Yandex Tank, Ixia); requirements analysis, test case and documentation development.
Built test environments, automated checks (bash, Python), incident escalation and triage.
Close work with engineering and support; demos, webinars, user manuals.

### 2011 — 2017 · Early career (system administration)
KrasotkaPro · MasterTEX · Neva-Retail · RIK-Computers — built and maintained IT
infrastructure: offices, warehouses, branches (~250 PCs, dozens of remote sites);
networks, servers, AD, virtualization (vSphere/KVM), backups, monitoring;
helpdesk, incident response, on-site work; basic automation and documentation.

## Frequently asked questions

### How can I find a DevOps mentor?
Start with open mentorship platforms (MentorCruise, GetMentor, Codementor, Хабр Карьера)
or reach out directly to a practicing Senior DevOps engineer. Eduard Makedonskii runs
1-on-1 DevOps mentoring online; the fastest way to start is Telegram [@edmak](https://t.me/edmak).

### What does Eduard help mentees with?
Career start or switch (entering IT, switching IT specialty), skills development
(Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS, observability, SRE, Linux), assessment (skills, portfolio,
resume review, salary expectations), job search (resume for Russian and international
markets, interview preparation, mock interviews), real-world task and project help,
and building an international career.

### What is Eduard's specialization?
Core specialization: CI/CD and the automation around it — Kubernetes / GitOps / Terraform /
Ansible / Jenkins / GitLab CI. Experience with high-load systems, building observability
(Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, ELK), and rolling out new platforms. CKA certified.

### Can Eduard help with DevOps transformation for a startup?
Yes. He helps startups build DevOps practices from scratch (IaC, CI/CD, GitOps,
observability, security) or accelerate an in-progress transformation.
Format: team mentoring, one-off consultation, or part-time engagement.

### Is Eduard available for part-time or contract work?
Yes. Available for part-time, project-based / one-off tasks, and contracts. Remote,
located in Russia. Stack: Kubernetes / Helm / ArgoCD / Terraform / Ansible / AWS /
GCP / Yandex Cloud / Python / Go.

### Does Eduard teach how to pass interviews?
No — he is strongly against "interview hacking" schools and shares real knowledge and
experience rather than scripted answers. He can run a mock interview, identify weak
spots, and share practical preparation insights.

### What languages does Eduard work in?
Russian (native) and English (working proficiency, B2). He can mentor in English and
help with English-language resumes and interview preparation for international companies.
